name: a
meaning: slope of p_cal = sigmoid(a logit(P4B) + b)
fitted_on: 3 aggregate public Doc P (J4-K40 0.376; K4-thr-C 0.2346; J3-thrC 0.2357)

name: s_free
meaning: global scale of expected gold count G_q in the free frame

name: g_depth
meaning: cosine depth for G_q = s_free (sum p_cal top-211 + tail)

name: depth (D)
meaning: candidate pool per query (cosine top-300 of corpus)

name: t_c
meaning: P4B threshold of the free frame (handoff)

name: rho
meaning: CR-fair share: carriers per query = ceil(rho |D_q|)

name: T
meaning: body length above which a 768-token window is added (FULL_MIN_T floor)

name: THIN_JUNK_SHARE
meaning: carrier is thin if >= 50% of chunk is base64 lines or {placeholders}

name: F2 marginal rule
meaning: add a doc only if its precision > current F2 / 5
